C0350.title: Nanjing Bank Former President Embezzlement Case and Sub-Account Risks
C0350.summary: Shu Xingnong, former president of Nanjing Bank, misappropriated 480 million yuan in reserve funds for personal investments, exposing a dysfunctional internal control system.
